releases.displayName: Discover The Season of Scares Update!

items.text: Get ready for a frightfully fun update with Season of Scares, now available on all platforms!

This Halloween, Oogie Boogie from Disney Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas is bringing his tricks to the Valley. Investigate a mysterious mirror in Scrooge’s Store, step through to a strange new version of the shop, take on his games, and uncover what this Halloween trickster has planned.
And that's not all! Season of Scares introduces new decorating tools, exciting new events, the Event Board, Decoration Preset code sharing, Floating Island improvements, and more.

notes.title: A Halloween Adventure with Oogie Boogie

items.text: Oogie Boogie has arrived in the Valley, and he's ready to cause some trouble!
Follow the strange happenings surrounding a mysterious mirror in Scrooge McDuck's Store and venture through it, where new games, challenges and rewards await each week.
Want to know when to check in and what to expect? Check out our dedicated Oogie Boogie's Halloween Event blog for the full event schedule and everything you need to know.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/f06161de03b002d088d15e33f45c0969f88aca45.png"]
It's time to give your Valley a bewitching Halloween makeover with the Haunting Elegance Star Path!
Unlock charming outfits, darkly whimsical furniture, Halloween-inspired decorations, and more as you complete Star Path Duties.
Give your home a festive new look with the Tricks and Treats House and get Scrooge McDuck ready for the season with a new Dream Style.

notes.title: A Season of Scares Premium Shop

items.text: The Premium Shop is getting into the Halloween spirit with plenty of new ways to dress up your Valley.
Look out for the Evil & Good Witch Bundle, featuring magical outfits, enchanting furniture, and matching bee-witching Companions.
You'll also be able to become Little Red Riding Hood, inspired by Disney's television series Once Upon a Time, complete with a Big Bad Wolf-inspired canine Companion.
Other additions include Stitch's Vampire Costume Dream Style, a new Sinister Bridge Kit with a matching garden set, and a Companion Bundle featuring Lucifer from Disney's Cinderella.
Decoration Presets are getting a major upgrade in Season of Scares, with a brand-new way to share your favorite designs with other Valley Villagers!

You can now create and share your own Presets using code sharing. Simply hover over any of your Presets to generate a unique code that you can give to other Valley Villagers. Codes are valid for 14 days, even if the creator has changed or removed the original Preset.
Looking for a little inspiration? We're also giving you three ready-to-use Decoration Presets inspired by the season, so you can create your very own witchy backyard with just a few clicks!
Keep an eye on our socials to get the codes, then show us how you make them your own! Once added to your collection, these Presets are yours to use whenever you'd like to celebrate the season.

notes.title: New Ways to Decorate Your Valley

items.text: With new ways to share your designs, Season of Scares also gives you more freedom to build and refresh your Valley.
More Freedom with Floating Islands
Looking for even more room to bring your ideas to life?

You can now move select characters stalls and some functional buildings around the Valley on Floating Islands, opening up even more possibilities for your Valley layouts. Expansion versions of eligible stalls and buildings can also be moved to their corresponding expansion’s Floating Island. Check out the latest Patch Notes for the full list of buildings and stalls that can be placed on Floating Islands.
Clear Biomes Instantly
Ever wanted to redecorate a Biome without having to remove everything piece by piece?

The new Clear Biome feature lets you quickly remove Furniture, Landscaping, Fences, and Paths from a Biome or Sub-Biome. Choose exactly what you want to clear, and if you change your mind, you can undo your changes before saving.
We're also expanding Biome-specific crafting with a new collection of witchy furniture inspired by the Forest of Valor.
With so much happening around the Valley, it can be tricky to keep track of it all. That's where the new Event Board comes in!

The Astronomer's Journey Star Path is a permanent introductory Star Path available to all players. After unlocking your first Realm and speaking with Merlin, you’ll begin the Astronomer’s Journey Star Path and be introduced to the new Event Board, which you’ll be asked to place in the Plaza. Complete quests around the Valley at your own pace to unlock special astronomy-inspired rewards. For Apple Arcade players, this will be available in our next free update.
Use the Event Board to keep track of up to three live events without having to search through your Menu, leave messages, and see messages from Valley Visitors.
Olaf's Grand Exhibition reaches its grand finale with two new rooms inspired by the Forgotten Lands and Valley Plaza.
Complete the Exhibition to unlock two new stunning furniture pieces and a Scholarly Fox Companion as a reward for your hard work.
Season of Scares also brings several improvements to Photo Mode and emotes.
Photo Mode Gallery

Your Gallery can now hold up to 12 pictures, while the DreamSnaps Archive lets you browse six months of DreamSnaps. You can also pin up to three favorite entries and share previous entries, with QR codes making it easier to share your favorite creations.

QR codes expire after 7 days, while the DreamSnaps Archive automatically removes the oldest unpinned entries after six months. Gallery contents will be automatically cleared after 180 days of inactivity.
Emote Wheel

Strike a pose anywhere in your Valley with the new Emote Wheel! Use emotes and poses outside of Photo Mode while exploring, decorating, or spending time with your favorite Villagers. Perform emotes around your Villagers to see how they react, or show off your moves to friends while playing in multiplayer!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/4759eafe20369c6c3f331ec26d03f70115e764cd.png"]
The Halloween festivities don't stop with Oogie Boogie!
Haunted Floating Festival : October 7–31
Explore the decorated festival grounds, solve new and returning puzzles, and earn exclusive seasonal decorations.
Trick or Treat : October 14–31

Collect delicious Trick or Treater’s Bounty around the Plaza or go door to door at homes featuring a jack-o'-lantern at the door to collect candy. This year's rewards include new exterior decorations inspired by Halloween Town from Disney Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas.

We can't wait for you to experience everything Season of Scares has to offer! From Oogie Boogie's challenges and new ways to share your creations, to exciting decorating upgrades and Halloween festivities throughout the Valley, there's plenty to discover.

items.text: Hey Valley Villagers!
We’re just cackling at having shared a first look at the Season of Scares free update in our latest \[Developer Update] video! Now, let’s dive into what you can expect from this update.

In Season of Scares, you'll meet the trickster Oogie Boogie, from Disney Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas, in a six-week Halloween bash for the ages! This time you'll need to complete a series of thrilling challenges to unlock Jack Skellington's rival and a ghostly canine.
Disney Dreamlight Valley’s Season of Scares free update arrives on September 23, 2026. Check out all the details below!
To kick off the events of Season of Scares, you’ll need to unlock The Peaceful Meadow, Scrooge McDucks's Store and Chez Remy's restaurant.
Investigate a strange mirror that has appeared in Scrooge McDuck's shop and enter it to discover Oogie Boogie's lair!

Now here's the trick – this time instead of unlocking Oogie Boogie first and then tackling his quests, you'll earn your rewards and unlock him by playing through his tricky challenges, from September 23rd to November 4th.
Complete all six weeks of Oogie Boogie's challenges, from choosing to (or not to) go along with his schemes, all the way to a final showdown — to permanently welcome him into your Valley!

At some point in your weekly trials, you may encounter a ghostly loyal companion ... That’s right – in one of Oogie Boogie’s quests you’ll be able to unlock Zero, from Disney Tim Burton’s The Nightmare Before Christmas.

Beware, after November 4th, Oogie Boogie will be leaving the Valley until Halloween next year... but worry not! As long as you begin the first of these quests before November 4, you’ll be able to unlock Oogie Boogie and Zero at your own pace.

Along with the Season of Scares arrives the frightfully delightful Haunting Elegance Star Path! Charm all your trick-or-treating guests with new bewitching attires and adorn your Valley with new dark whimsical furniture pieces. Give your house a festive new look with the Tricks and Treats House and get Scrooge McDuck in the mood for a good scare with the perfect Skeleton Scrooge Dream Style.

October 7th marks the return of the Haunted Floating Festival event! Until October 31st, explore the decorated festival grounds to discover new and returning puzzles, and earn exclusive seasonal decorations for solving them!

Then, Starting October 14th until October 31st, the Trick or Treat event is back, featuring an all-new way to earn candy! Collect frightfully delicious Trick-or-Treater's Bounty from around the Plaza, or now, by going door to door, trick-or-treating at houses that feature a jack-o'-lantern outside! New rewards for this year include Disney Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas Halloween Town exterior decorations!
Arriving to the Premium Shop this update is the Evil & Good Witch Bundle, featuring new wickedly magical attires, enchanting new furniture pieces and matching bee-witching companions.

This Halloween you’ll also be able to dress up as Red Riding Hood with a new costume inspired by Disney’s television series Once Upon a Time, complete with its very own new Red Riding Hood Wolf companion!
Stitch will also be embracing the festivities with his new Vampire Costume Stitch Dream Style.

Season of Scares will also come with a new Sinister Bridge Kit, complete with its own garden set, and a new Companion Bundle welcoming Lucifer, from Disney's Cinderella, who arrives with the special ability to chase after critters, gathering rewards and unique Photo Mode poses.
In Season of Scares, we’re introducing the Event Board! This new feature is part of the new introductory Star Path: the Astronomer’s Journey Star Path. See below for more details.
Decoration Presets codes are here! Create and share your Presets with other Valley Villagers using code sharing!
As of this update, you’ll also be able to place some gameplay buildings on floating islands. See below for details.
Finaly, the last rooms in Olaf's Grand Exhibition will be opening, along with all new rewards for those who complete all the exhibition rooms!

You’ll also want to keep an eye out on the Scrooge McDuck Store for brand-new weekly items such as the Aqua Mermaid Backpack, the Scarlet Gothic Chair, the Cozy Autumn Bed, Botanical Vine Flower Lamp, and more.
Seasonal Moonstone packs will also be available for a limited time.

Please note: Disney Dreamlight Valley Apple Arcade Edition does not include access to the Premium Shop. In addition, the Haunted Elegance Star Path on Apple Arcade will be delayed until later this October, and both the Event Board and Astronomer’s Journey Star Path will only be available in our next free update.
Final Rooms and Completion Rewards
Finally, Olaf's Grand Exhibition will be opening its two final rooms based on the Forgotten Lands and Valley Plaza.
The Plaza exhibition room will come with 2 Dioramas and a companion Habitat.

Each time a room is completed, a Biome icon will appear on the lobby carpet. Once all 8 rooms are completed, 3 chests containing the Grand Exhibition’s completion rewards will appear. These rewards will consist of two stunning new furniture pieces – the Grand Exhibition Window and the Grand Exhibition Fountain – and a delightful new Scholarly Fox companion for all your hard work.
Presets Code Sharing
Decoration Presets codes are here!

Create and share your Presets with other Valley Villagers using code sharing! By selecting Share Presets in the Presets option menu, you'll now be able to generate a unique code that can be given to others to use.
Codes are valid for 14 days, even if the creator of the Preset has changed or removed their creation.
We've also updated the Mirage function.
If an item can be found in the Premium Shop, you will be redirected to it.
If the item is from a current Star Path, it will redirect you to the correct page.
If the item was from a limited series or bundle, and/or is not currently available, you will see a pop-up saying, “This item is not available for now.”
Mirages in Edit Mode
Remove creative blockers with Mirage, or two.

If you’re low on decorations when using the Duplicate option in Edit Mode, you will no longer need to stop and go searching for items. Instead, you’ll place a Mirage placeholder and be able to continue creating!
Floating Islands

As of this update, we're helping further unlock your decorative creativity by allowing for some functional buildings around the Valley and stalls, including most character stalls, to now be placed on floating islands.

New Biome Crafting Recipes
We're expanding the new Biome-specific crafting recipes!
In Season of Scares, you’ll be able to complete a mysterious array of new witchy-inspired arcane furniture pieces for your Forest of Valor.
Clear Biome
Finally arriving in this update is an all-new way to remove items from any of your Biomes!

You ‘ll be able to toggle and choose if you want to clear Furniture (furniture and decorations), Landscaping (decorative trees, bushes, and rocks), Fences, and/or Paths from any decorated Biome (or Sub-Biome for expansions).
Apple Arcade Star Path

That's right, if you play on Apple Arcade, you'll now also get new Star Path events every update! The first Apple Arcade Star Path, Haunting Elegance, will launch later this October. These will function similarly to the regular Star Paths on consoles, with the following differences:
There will be no Premium Track or Premium Rewards.
There will be no Moonstones or purchasable Tokens.
Weekly Routine Duties will be replaced by Daily Duties.
Instead of Routine Duties engagement unlocking Vault rewards, you will have Daily Duties unlocking “Milestone Rewards”.
These rewards will be made up of consumable items like Star Coins, Dreamlight, Potions, etc.
New Introductory Star Path
Participate in a new permanent Star Path: The Astronomer's Journey Star Path.
After having unlocked your first realm and speaking to Merlin, you'll be able to start completing this new introductory Star Path.
Progress at your own pace by completing quests around the Valley to unlock special astronomy-based rewards.
As with all other introductory quests, this Star Path can only be completed once.
For Apple Arcade players, this will be available in our next free update.
Event Board
In this update, we’re introducing the Event Board.
While completing The Astronomer’s Journey Star Path, you will be introduced to the new Event Board, which you’ll be asked to place in the Plaza.
The Event Board is a physical item in your Valley that allows you to keep track of up to three live events without having to search your Menu!
For Apple Arcade players, this will be available in our next free update.
We've made improvements to Photo Mode that will make it easier than ever to share your favorite pics!
My Saved Photos
You’ll now be able to save up to 12 photos from Photo Mode.
These saved pictures can be viewed, submitted to DreamSnaps (if eligible), shared with friends (by creating a QR code), or shared to your DreamTeams feed.
Saved pictures can be deleted at any time.
DreamSnaps Archive
Your recent DreamSnaps submissions will be auto saved in the DreamSnaps Archive once the Challenge is done, and results are sent, for up to 6 months.
You’ll also be able to pin up to 3 favorites to keep them!
Pinned DreamSnaps are never auto-removed.
Unpinned DreamSnaps are removed once their expiration timer runs out.
QR Codes
You’ll now be able to generate QR codes for your saved pictures that will last 7 days.
You’ll be able to have 12 codes at a time.
Also important to note that your Photo Gallery and DreamSnaps Archive will live on your online profile, so you'll want to stay signed in and active to keep them saved!
If you don't play for 180 days, Saved Photos and DreamSnaps Archive entries are deleted automatically.
Finally, sharing a photo on the DreamTeams feed or generating a QR code doesn't remove it from your Photo Gallery.
Emotes Wheel
You'll now be able to strike a pose and emote outside of Photo Mode with the new Emote Wheel!
At launch, there will be 11 free emotes available for use.
You’ll be able to perform these emotes in multiplayer and watch your friends react to them, or around your own Villagers and see their reactions!
Super Votes
Introducing a new “Super Vote” option!
To help reward the most mesmerizing submissions, you’ll be able to vote for BOTH presented DreamSnaps at the same time using a Super Vote!
You’ll have 2 Super Votes per day.
Updated Visual Interface
We’ve updated the UI in the 1v1 voting screens to standardize the way DreamSnaps are presented. This means both images will occupy the same amount of space.
You'll still have the option to view any image in “full screen” before voting.
Map Improvements
We've started rolling out improvement on the Map that will help reduce clutter, contains more information, and overall makes it easier to interact with your Villagers:
Map Uncluttering which redistributes the character icons when they are in the same building.
Cursor proximity mode makes icons fan out when the cursor is placed over them for simpler selection.
On-hover cursor info is updated.
A new Avatar orientation indicator tells you which way you’re facing.
Missing labels, icons, and caves have been added.
And Fast Travel improvements, like opening on the Favorites by default.
More Map improvements will be rolled out in future updates, so stay tuned!
New Shop Bundle Type
For the first time, you'll be able to update Villager Houses with their own House Skins, starting with the Snowy Beast’s Castle!
General Economy Update

In the Season of Scares, we've rolled out updates on the value of various in-game content, like the cost of unlocking Realms, or Villager houses, to provide an overall more cohesive gameplay experience. See details here: LINK

Hey, Valley Villagers!
Get ready to power up your Valley with our latest update: Pixel Perfect, now available on all platforms!

In this update, you'll get to team up with the Forgotten once again to investigate a series of mysterious glitchy arcade machines appearing throughout the Valley. Follow the clues, uncover the source of the chaos, and help bring Ralph from Disney's Wreck-It Ralph to the Valley.
To begin your journey, both the Forgotten and Peter Pan will need to be unlocked, and you need to have completed the quest "The Music's on the Walls."

As you investigate strange glitches appearing throughout the Valley, a mysterious arcade machine begins showing up in unexpected places. Complete the machine's strange requests to uncover its mysterious origins.

What starts as a strange glitch quickly grows into a much bigger mystery. By following the clues, you'll discover the truth behind the arcade machine and help reunite Ralph with his friends in the Valley.
Once Ralph settles back in, you'll help him get back into the swing of Valley life.

Help Ralph conduct a Bad-Anon meeting, reconnect with Vanellope, make new friends, and settle into his new home. As you level up your Friendship with Ralph, you'll take part in arcade-inspired adventures, friendly competitions, scavenger hunts, and even help repair some unexpected chaos after Ralph accidentally causes a few glitches of his own.
Of course, no update centered around Friendship would be complete without some exciting new ways to spend time with your favorite Villagers.
Friendship is getting a major upgrade in Pixel Perfect!

As of this update, Friendship Level 10 is evolving into something brand new: Best Friends! Strengthen your bonds with your favorite Villagers to unlock special perks, enhanced bonuses, and exciting new ways to spend time together throughout the Valley.
Want to learn more? Be sure to check out our dedicated Your Guide to Best Friends blog for a complete breakdown of the feature.

Transform your Valley with city-core items, vibrant lighting, stylish performance outfits, and rewards inspired by the excitement of live music.
Unlock standout rewards including luminous stage pieces, show-stopping fashions inspired by Marie and Berlioz from Disney's The Aristocats, and a lovable calico cat companion.
Whether you're creating the perfect performance space or dressing for your next DreamSnaps entry, this Star Path is ready to steal the spotlight.
The Premium Shop is getting a stylish refresh with plenty of new ways to personalize your Valley.

Bring a splash of summer to your favorite Biomes with the new Deluxe Tropical Valley Bundle, featuring vibrant new looks for all iconic Valley locations. You'll also be able to light up your skies with the all-new Meteor Shower Sky Environmental Effect, perfect for creating magical DreamSnaps moments.

Additional highlights include the Scholarly Owl and Fantasia Broomstick companions, a new Village Schoolhouse House Style and matching Village Schoolhouse Kit, plus select Premium Shop bundles that now include premade Decoration Presets to help bring your dream designs to life even faster!

notes.title: New Ways to Decorate Your Valley

Expand your decorating possibilities with new Biome-inspired crafting recipes, beginning with a collection of whimsical furniture pieces themed around the Peaceful Meadow. You'll also be able to Quick Save your decorating progress while still in Edit Mode, helping ensure your latest creations are never lost.

Owners of Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Storybook Vale will also be able to unlock three brand-new Floating Islands inspired by the Bind, Mythopia, and Everafter, using Story Magic, with even more room to build and decorate.
Olaf's Grand Exhibition continues to grow with two brand-new rooms opening their doors as of this update.
Journey through the Sunlit Plateau- and Frosted Heights-themed Exhibition rooms, each featuring new collections to complete and rewards to unlock.
Continue celebrating your adventures throughout the Valley while showcasing even more of your favorite memories and accomplishments!

Hey Valley Villagers!
We’re thrilled to have shared a first look at the Pixel Perfect free update in our latest Developer Update video! Now, let’s jump into the details of what you can expect in this update.

In Pixel Perfect, you’ll once again team up with The Forgotten, this time to fix an old arcade machine and bring Ralph, from Disney’s Wreck-It Ralph to your Valley! You’ll also be able to become Best Friends with your Villagers, upgrade your decorating skills with all new features and highly requested improvements, and much more!
Disney Dreamlight Valley’s Pixel Perfect free update arrives on July 29, 2026. Check out all the details below!
To kick off the events of Pixel Perfect, you’ll need to unlock The Forgotten and Peter Pan and complete the quest “The Music on the Wall”.
Join the Forgotten as you investigate a glitchy arcade machine near the Dream Castle. This glitchy relic will make a few more apparitions before ending up in Vanellope’s home.
Search your Valley for pies, root beer, and bricks that you’ll need to repair the arcade and set up a beacon to free Ralph!
Once setup in your Valley, help Ralph conduct a Bad-Anon meeting, reconnect with Vanellope, make some new friends, wreck a little mayhem, then fix it, to unlock awesome rewards!

Get ready to power up with the Pop City Star Path! Transform your Valley and put together a show for the stars with new luminous stage pieces and concert attires! Meet a new loveable feline companion, the paw-fect partner for this new Star Path, as well as two new outfits inspired by Marie and Berlioz from Disney’s Aristocats!

This update we’re also bringing back the Summer Sizzle event, from August 5th to August 18th, where you’ll collect marshmallows, share smores with your friends and complete daily quests around the Valley to unlock brand-new rewards – the first ever dock building.

Pixel Perfect will also feature a brand-new Parks Floating Festival! Arriving to the Valley from August 19th to September 8th, enter and explore the thematic floating island inspired by the best of Disney Parks to complete weekly puzzles and earn magical rewards.

Then from September 16th to September 29th, the Memory Mania event will return with new quests for you to complete alongside Joy from Disney’s Inside Out. Help spot the differences in memories, and you’ll be able to unlock a brand-new companion!

A new update means cool new swag! Coming to the Premium Shop is a brand-new Deluxe Tropical Valley Bundle that’ll give your Valley a splash of color with vibrant new looks for the Plaza, Dream Castle, Daisy’s Boutique, Chez Remy’s, Scrooge’s Store, and Valley Visit Station.

Alongside this new bundle arrives an all-new Environmental Effects item to the Premium Shop! The first of this kind is the Meteor Shower Sky - Fill your skies with cosmic showers, perfect for late night star watching or adding an extra radiant touch to your photos!

Get into the back-to-school spirit with a new Village Schoolhouse Skin, along with the matching Village Schoolyard Kit. Also coming this update is the charming Scholarly Owl companion and the new ionic Fantasia Broomstick companion.

In addition, we're bringing premade Presets to the Premium Shop. Select bundles, including some existing ones, will now arrive with premade Presets, allowing you to decorate your Valley with greater ease!

You’ll also want to keep an eye out on the Scrooge McDuck Store for brand-new weekly items such as Pink Leopard Tank Top, Dreamlight Varsity Jacket, Artist's Overalls, Enchanted Castle Tuxedo, Crimson Wayfinder Patterned Skirt, and more.
Seasonal Moonstone packs will also be available for a limited time.
Please note: Disney Dreamlight Valley Apple Arcade Edition does not include seasonal Star Paths or access to the Premium Shop.

UPDATE: We're happy to confirm that the Nintendo version of tomorrow's Pixel Perfect update will not contain the incompatible Clear Biome feature. Our team is still working on mitigating this issue for our Apple players.

The Pixel Perfect update was originally meant to include a "Clear Biome" feature in Furniture mode. Unfortunately, we discovered a critical bug in this feature last week, and have patched it out of the Xbox, PlayStation, Steam and Epic versions of the Pixel Perfect update. However, the feature will still be present in the Nintendo and Apple versions of the update and using it could impact various quests' progress. We recommend that our Nintendo and Apple players avoid using this feature for the time being. A hotfix will be deployed to patch the incompatible Clear Biome feature out of the Pixel Perfect update on Nintendo and Apple in the coming days. The feature will return in a later update.
New Exhibition Rooms

Finally, Olaf’s Grand Exhibition will be opening two brand new rooms for you to complete, centered on the Sunlit Plateau and the Frosted Heights. Both arriving with their own unique rewards for completion.
General Improvements
We’ve revamped and improved how you engage with your Valley pals.
You’ll now be able to use Training Manuals to change any villager’s role, at any level.
We’re also revisiting crafting recipes to facilitate making Manuals!
You’ll also be able to select multiple individual items from your inventory to gift at once.
Speaking of gifts, you’ll now be able to re-roll each favorite gift, once per day.
New Friendship Perks
We’ve also updated the perks that come with leveling up your Friendships.

Level 7 friends will now also be able to assist you in gathering items! You will now be able to pick 1 item related to your friend’s base roles from any unlocked biome, and request that they collect more for you. The following day, you’ll be able to claim your item bundles from your friend.
There are no limits to how many friends you can request help from.
Friends will remain available in the Valley while they’re out searching for items.
You’ll now also be able to use your Map to Fast Travel to any of your level 10 friends.
Best Friends!
As of Pixel Perfect, you’ll be able to be Best Friends with your Valley’s villagers!

Once a villager reaches Level 10 Friendship, their Star Icon will be replaced with a Gold Heart progress bar. This progress bar, for all villagers, will reset daily and can only be filled once per day.
Once the new Gold Heart progress bar is filled, you’ll be able to hangout with your Best Friend and get limited time perks!
You and your Best Friend will have a Best Friend Glow that will last a limited time and will unlock max level roles bonus for ALL roles.
Sprinting will now affect your Best Friend Glow duration but not your Stamina.
Best Friends hangouts can only be had once per day, per villager.

Complete crafter recipes utilizing ingredients from your base game Biomes to create unique furniture sets!
In Pixel Perfect, you’ll be able to complete a stunning array of new fae-inspired whimsical furniture pieces for your Peaceful Meadow.
Edit Mode Quick Save

Storybook Vale Floating Islands
This update will also introduce three brand-new floating islands for owners of the Disney Dreamlight Valley - The Storybook Vale expansion.
Each island will be themed after Biomes found within the expansion, such as The Bind, Mythopia, and Everafter.
General Improvements
We’ve updated the UI in the 1v1 voting screens to standardize the way DreamSnaps are presented. This means both images will occupy the same amount of space.
You'll still have the option to view any image in “full screen” before voting.
Environmental Effects
Brand new type of decor for your Valley!
The Menu UI has been updated to include a “Special” section for Environmental Effects, like the Aurora Borealis and upcoming Meteor Shower Sky.
These Environmental Effects can be applied per area (Biome, Sub-Biome, or Floating Island).

Honeyglow Woods is the first ever Disney Dreamlight Valley adventure pack – a new optional paid add-on to be experienced alongside our usual free content updates. This is a new type of experience that allows us to create a unique adventure with thematic landscapes to decorate, a brand-new story, and a cast of loveable characters for those who wish to bring a little extra Disney magic to their Village. notes.title: NEW CONTENT (HONEYGLOW WOODS ADVENTURE PACK OWNERS)

items.text: Embark on this new adventure by planting a Tree Sprout until it grows into a magical glowing tree gateway that you’ll be able to place anywhere in your Valley or your base game Floating Islands – you’ll also be able to remove and/or replace this magical gateway at any time.

Discover a brand-new gameplay mechanic, Beekeeping! Place flowers around a Busy Bees’ House, to pollinate the flowers and generate more honey in the houses – a fully pollinated Busy Bees’ House will increase the growth speeds of other nearby flowers!
You'll also be able to move these Busy Bees’ Houses to any of your other biomes, including your base game Valley!
Keep your eyes peeled for the absolutely adorable Hedgehogs! These new little cuties will come with their own Photo Mode poses!

items.text: Hey Valley Villagers,
Prepare for an epic new adventure with our latest update: The Path of the Hero, now available on all platforms!

Step into a brand-new Realm and embark on a series of heroic trials to uncover the mystery behind the restless gods and help guide Hercules from Disney’s Hercules back to your Valley, working alongside his legendary mentor Phil from Disney’s Hercules.

notes.title: A Realm Worthy of a Hero

items.text: To begin your journey, unlock the Hercules Realm and explore Phil’s training island. The moment you arrive, it’s easy to see that something’s not quite right. Dark Thorns have started to appear, and a mysterious fog has settled over the woods.
With Hercules nowhere to be found after heading deeper into the forest, it’s up to you to follow the trail and discover what’s happened.

To make sure you’re strong enough to chase Hercules into the fog, Phil has prepared special training challenges. Take on obstacle courses where you’ll clear Dark Thorns, activate Moonlight Beacons, and collect rewards as you prove your skills.

As you progress, unlock new abilities and divine tools that will help you on your journey. Travel through shadowed forests, across perilous cliffs, and into an ancient temple. Along the way, earn the favor of different gods through troubled terrain, and ultimately solve the mystery of who caused the chaos in the Realm in the first place. When you’re done, you’ll guide Hercules and Phil back to the Valley.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/c5abfdbfd1f48e21596486e37f19e2ade7bf9b2d.png"]
Channel your inner deity with the Godly Glamor Star Path, where myths meet elegance.

Earn radiant new outfits, divine-inspired furniture, and mythical companions as you progress through your journey. From glowing celestial designs to majestic decor fit for the gods, every reward will bring a touch of Olympus to your Valley.
Also unlock standout rewards such as the Mythical Cloud Glider, Pink Baby Pegasus companion, Hercules’ Divine Glow Dream Style, and the Olympian Cloud Mansion House Style.

notes.title: A Heroic Update to the Premium Shop

items.text: The Premium Shop is getting a heroic refresh with new items inspired by the world of Hercules and the gods.

Step into mythic style with the Gilded Agora Building Kit, featuring the majestic Grecian Villa House Style, and the ability to summon a fierce new ally with the “good-good-good” puppy Cerberus companion.

You’ll also find the new Cozy Companion Rajah Bundle, featuring Rajah, Jasmine’s loyal companion, bringing unique interactions with Aladdin and Jasmine, Photo Mode poses, an exclusive friendship reward, and even a Tiger Cub companion.
Additional highlights include a new Dream Style for Ariel, Moana’s parade float, and new mount accessories arriving in the Shop.

notes.title: New Ways to Decorate Your Valley

items.text: We’re introducing Decoration Presets, a brand-new way to decorate your Valley with ease.
This feature works alongside Group Mode and allows you to select a section of your Valley and save it as a Preset. You can then remove, copy, and replace fully decorated areas whenever you like.
If you don’t own enough of an item in a saved Preset, a Mirage placeholder will appear, letting you quickly craft or purchase what’s missing and place it instantly.
\[Exhibition Screenshot]
Olaf’s Grand Exhibition is growing with two new rooms arriving in this update: the Forest of Valor and the Glade of Trust.
Continue building your collection and celebrate your Valley journey by showcasing even more of your favorite memories and achievements.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/72b597a089eacb9ea93408208b18dbd07c73a8be.png"]

Celebrate the return of the Dreamlight Parks Fest! Collect buttons throughout your Valley to earn returning favorites as well as brand-new rewards.

items.text: Hey Valley Villagers!

Step through a new realm door to arrive on a training island owned by the wise satyr, Phil! But wait, this once illuminated island is severely dimmed... Could this be the Realmweaver's handywork? Train and prove you’re fit to be a hero and help illuminate the island once again!

items.text: Hey, Valley Villagers!
Prepare for a magical adventure with the Whispers of the Wind update, now available on all platforms!

Step into the breathtaking beauty of nature as you welcome Pocahontas from Disney's Pocahontas to the Valley. Follow the whispers of the wind, uncover hidden secrets, and embark on a heartwarming journey that leads you to Pocahontas's loyal companion, Meeko.

notes.title: A Journey in the Heart of Nature

items.text: To begin your journey with Pocahontas, you will first need to have Moana as a Villager and have unlocked both the Dazzle Beach and Forest of Valor Biomes.

A gentle, mysterious wind will guide your way. Join Moana and follow the mysterious swirling leaves as they lead you toward a soft glow across the ocean, where something magical awaits. Together, you'll uncover Memories on a mysterious island tied to a rare natural event that once lit up the Valley, and meet a new friend along the way.
Help Pocahontas prepare a Celestial Celebration, a Valley festival honoring the Moontide Glow, a magical phenomenon that lights up the waters of Dazzle Beach.

From preparing food and crafting decorations to helping set the scene for the festival, everyone in the Valley has a role to play. Along the way, you'll deepen your bond with Pocahontas, unlock beautiful nature-inspired rewards and eventually welcome Meeko as a new companion.
A brand-new feature coming in this update displays the magic of your Valley adventures!

Step into Olaf's Grand Exhibition, a special hub where you can showcase your collections and celebrate your achievements. At launch, you'll be able to explore rooms dedicated to the Peaceful Meadow and Dazzle Beach. Share flowers in Dioramas, fish in Aquariums, and companions in Habitats.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/e0a57fa0dcbe1f988cd622d5b07ec2401ebae6e2.png"]

Keep an eye out, as some Vault rewards will appear gradually throughout the update, and there might be a few surprises waiting for you! Read more about this new feature in our Q&A blog.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/1331e4d9a3ed65f5ea50c7185c011d1490f285b4.png"]

Be sure to check out the portal in your Plaza during those days so you don't miss out!
Then, from May 27 to June 9, dig up Treasure Cracks, follow clues, and uncover hidden rewards. You can also try fishing for extra treasures in the Treasure Hunt event.

Create or join a community with up to seven friends! Customize your team’s name, motto, and motif, and request or trade items with other members. This new feature is made up of 4 subsections:
Your DreamTeam
This tab of the DreamTeam menu allows you to manage your DreamTeam’s identity.
Join or create your own DreamTeam.
Once part of a DreamTeam, you can view your team's information and Activity Log, as well as leave the group.

For owners: you can manage your team’s name, motto, and icon, as well as invite others and view your members’ Activity Logs. You can also transfer ownership to another member or dissolve your DreamTeam entirely.
Members
This section lists all members of the DreamTeam, along with key details about each of them.
You can view all members’ portraits, names, overall collections, and Realm Door unlocked.
You can also open a Detailed Profile Card for each member, which includes information such as Current DreamSnaps Ranking, and Main Story Progression.
For owners: you can manage and remove other members from the DreamTeam.
Item Sharing
Members of a DreamTeam can use this tab to request items they need and fulfill requests made by others.
To request an item, open your Request Box and add an item - you'll need to have previously owned it in order to request it.
You can make up to two requests per day. This means all four Request Boxes can be filled over two days if no donations are received.
To donate, open a member’s Request Box, select one of their requested items, then select from your own inventory, and send them a specific quantity of that item.
IMPORTANT: When playing on a Nintendo or MacOS device, the Pixel Shards received for making donations will not be added to your inventory. A fix for this will be implemented shortly.
Team Feed
Members of a DreamTeam can share and react to pictures with one another.
You can share pictures to your Team Feed directly through Photo Mode. You’ll also be able to view and react to other members’ pictures here.
DreamSnaps are automatically shared in the Team Feed. This function can be turned off in the settings.
You will have a maximum of two active shared pictures. Once this limit is reached, sharing a new picture will replace the oldest one.
Note: DreamTeams will not be available in the Disney Dreamlight Valley Apple Arcade Edition.
Track All Duties
You can now track all your active Star Path Duties at once.
Updated UI
A refreshed interface now highlights which rewards have been collected.
Auto-Claim
A new Auto-Claim feature for both Duties and Rewards can now be toggled on for those using the Premium Star Path.
Auto-claimed rewards will follow the numerical order shown on the Rewards screen (e.g., Reward 1, then Reward 2, and so on).
Active Period
As of The Winter Ball update, Star Path Duties will be prolonged by 24 hours (1 day). This means that the grace period will now last 24 hours.
Scrooge McDuck Store’s New Return Policy
You can now sell purchasable items back to Scrooge at 75% of their Star Coin value.
Shopping Improvements
A new search bar, filters, and sorting options have been added to Scrooge’s Delivery System to make browsing and purchasing easier.
Villager Toggle
You can now use a toggle to select which of your Valley’s Villagers appear in your photos.
Up to 15 unlocked Disney Dreamlight Villagers will be available to display.
New dynamic Dreamlight prices to unlock realm doors will allow for a more customized experience! After the first 3 doors, you can choose which realm door to unlock next.

items.text: Hey Valley Villagers!
Arrrr you ready to embark on your next Valley Adventure? Disney Dreamlight Valley’s latest free update, the Mysteries of Skull Rock, arrives today on all platforms.
Set sail to build friendships with two Villagers, dive into another seasonal Star Path, and uncover a bounty of upgrades for your Companions!
For those of you who have completed the main questline of the Disney Dreamlight Valley base game, the story continues with new quests with The Forgotten.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/4ffcd03e1c34932ccc93ba9ac1f953c76533b12a.png"]

Freely roaming about your Valley, they have discovered a special feather that jogs their memories regarding Skull Rock. You'll need to help them think of the happiest things, and even gain a real name - all culminating in discovering a way into the iconic Dazzle Beach locale.

Once inside, you’ll uncover a massive cavern with a ship at its center. But, before you can find the treasures it holds, Puzzling Pixie Flames await, challenging you with manipulating lights and shadows to navigate your way around the cave.
After working together, you’ll be able to give The Forgotten a less (or more) edgy name and work through friendship quests with them, all with new rewards.
But, that’s not the only Villager to join your Valley in the Mysteries of Skull Rock update. From Disney’s Peter Pan, the boy who loves to fly – Peter, himself, joins you!
That said, you’ve done a little bit of growing up since last you played – and you’ll need to convince him you are the friend that he remembers, ie. not a pirate.

This may involve capturing a pesky shadow that doesn’t stay underfoot – but wins you a friend who arrives with his own house – er, hideout – and leads to Peter restarting the Valley’s ‘Dreamlight Lost Kids’!

From an exciting new roadmap to the arrival of Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Storybook Vale Expansion Pass Part 2 on July 9th, there’s so much magic and adventure we can’t wait for you to explore.

Get ready to explore the Mysteries Skull Rock, and rekindle your friendship with the Forgotten to welcome the new youthful Villager from Disney’s Peter Pan! It's time to continue the story of the Forgotten and explore the depth of Skull Rock to find out what, and more importantly who, is hiding there!

Stepping out of Skull Rock, Peter Pan joins your Valley with spirited Friendship rewards and Quests. Convince him you’re not a treacherous pirate and progress in his questline to help him re-start his crew of Dreamlight Lost Boys!

Prepare to warmly welcome the Forgotten as a true Villager, unlocking the ability to hang out as well as new friendship items. You’ll even be able to give them a name, to make them feel right at home in your Valley!

Believe in the magic of wishful thinking with the Adventures in Never Land Star Path! Spend time with Peter Pan and complete various tasks to collect outfits inspired by Pirate and Mermaid fashions, unique decor and cosmetics, and unlock new Dream Styles for Goofy and Minnie.
Valiant treasure seekers, your time has come! Find special treasure maps around your Valley, solve riddles, and earn amazing rewards with the new Troves of Treasure Event.

What’s sweet, best enjoyed by a campfire, and tastes like summer? You got it, marshmallows! The Summer Sizzle Event arrives in your Valley – bringing back marshmallows, tasty treats and new rewards this season.
Sail to exciting summer adventures with the weekly DreamSnaps challenges arriving in Mysteries of Skull Rock!

New optional items are coming to the Premium Shop for a limited time, including a unique River Kit bundle that allows you to create your own waterway. But there is more! A new Companion Bundle arrives, introducing Max from Disney’s The Little Mermaid as an Animal Companion. Gather your furry, scaly, and feathered pals – friendship levels are here! Spend time and interact with your companions to level them up and get rewards. Bring companions along to collect bonus resources – each kind of companion will pick-up a specific type of resource:
Squirrels will help with Fruits
Rabbits will help with Vegetables
Turtles will help with Seafood
Sunbirds will help with Flowers
Foxes and Crocodiles will help with Fish
Raccoons and Whimsical Creatures will help with Gems
Ravens will help with Soils

Owls, Baby Dragons, and Pegasuses will help with Snippets

Some companions, especially notable named Disney companions, may not fit conventional categories and may bring special reward once you reach max friendship.

But that’s not all! Depending on their level of friendship, companions can help expand your player inventory and provide extra resources when equipped to your Avatar. As a cherry on top, you can now give a unique nickname to any regular critter that doesn’t already have a preset name, making them truly your own. Additionally, all companions will now appear in a dedicated section of the Collections Menu – perfect for keeping track of your loyal sidekicks!

Path Improvements: Unleash your creativity with an update to Paths, allowing you to place tiles diagonally! Seamlessly switch between Straight & Diagonal Modes for even more design flexibility and unique builds.
Grid Update: Explore new decorating possibilities with an expanded grid! More tiles will give you greater flexibility to place furniture items and customize your Valley in Decoration Mode.

Player House Style Improvements: Your favorite House, everywhere you go! A unique House Styles can now also be placed outside of your Valley, once in each Expansion area – and even on one of your Floating Islands!

New Photo Mode Improvements: You might need to sit to hear this 🪑... Photo Mode is getting additional enhancements in this update, including the option to sit while taking photos and new retouching options and toggles to perfect your shots!

Memory Improvements: Complete memories faster! Updates to the shards balancing ensure you now receive a new Memory Shard every time you get a memory orb when participating in activities around your Valley – unless you've already completed all memories related to that activity. Plus, there are now more chances to obtain memory orbs when watering dried flowers!
More Recommended Bundles: The Premium Shop recommended tab will now feature 6 bundles, giving you even more chances to discover items that match your style.
Uncrafting Station Balancing Fix: Corrected the Dreamlight cost of uncrafting certain items at the Uncrafting Station - such as paths - making it easier and less costly to reclaim materials.

releases.displayName: Discover the Tales of Agrabah Update!

items.text: Hey Valley Villagers!

Disney Dreamlight Valley’s first update of 2025, Tales of Agrabah, is now LIVE on all platforms! Swap out your winter sweaters for cooler wear, don your most stylish... or sneakiest (more on this, later!) sneakers, and get ready to dive into a new Realm, welcome 2 new Villagers, and MORE!

notes.title: A whole new Realm to explore!

items.text: Adventure awaits you in the Dream Castle behind the latest Realm Door – inspired by Disney’s Aladdin! Teleporting you to a market set in Agrabah, prepare your Avatar by dressing for the desert heat and… sandstorms?

Luckily for you, Jasmine is already on the case. Unfortunately for the market, a mysterious artifact has summoned strong winds that left unchecked will reduce everything to ruins! You’ll need to locate Aladdin in the Realm to uncover what he’s learned about the artifact – and through some clever use of your Royal Tools (and a little monkey-business), attempt to return things to normal. A familiar fabric friend will also lend you a hand, joining you as a companion once you leave the Realm!

Once you’ve ensured that the Realm has only sunny and storm-free days ahead, Aladdin and Jasmine will join your Valley as Villagers, with unique friendship questlines and splendid rewards. Jasmine will request your aid in rediscovering her memories of the Valley – culminating in taming some wishes gone wild!

Scrooge McDuck has an interesting task to welcome Aladdin to the Valley and test your own skills – break into his vault! With a new security system in place, work together on your sneaking skills to solve a new stealth gameplay mechanic.
If sneaking is too slow for you – don’t worry! Glide through the Valley in style by crafting your very own Dreamlight Tapestry with Aladdin through his questline!
After a hard day unlocking a new Realm, chasing critters, and/or harvesting 100 pumpkins – kick back and relax with the Oasis Retreat Star Path!

With resort-inspired fashions, wicker décor, and a delightful capybara animal companion that exudes tranquility wherever it roams, create the oasis of your dreams! Bonus rewards also return – inclusive of a new wood and wicker House Dream Style.

Additional stock arrives in Scrooge McDuck’s Store this season, along with new optional content in weekly Premium Shop rotations. Saving your Moonstones, but don’t want to miss out on a deal? As of this update, you’ll be able to pin up to two non-owned bundles from the Premium Shop to purchase at a later date!
Looking for more in-game content? You’re in luck!
The Eggstravaganza event returns with egg-cellent news: even. more. eggs! We’re introducing another color of egg to collect, and brand-new rewards.
A new event will also arrive this season, bringing rainbows of color to your Valley (leaning green…!).
Keep an eye on our social media accounts to learn more about these events in the near future.
If you’ve already unlocked Tiana, from Disney’s The Princess and the Frog, you’re in for a treat!

It seems she has found schematics for a new item in the Dreamlight Library – a Slow Cooker! Crafting this culinary classic will enable you to cue up multiple meals for a small Dreamlight cost – ensuring you have plenty of meals for your next play session.
Hungry for more cooking upgrades? We’ve got you covered with our…

Our team revels in taking the opportunity to develop new features and build upon existing content, taking inspiration from player feedback! Read on to discover just a few of these changes arriving in the Tales of Agrabah update:
The Search is over… for recipes! This update introduces a much-requested search bar to the Cooking menu – alongside other Cooking interface changes. Learn more in our update Patch Notes.

Expand the horizon of your decorating with new Floating Islands! Islands inspired by the Peaceful Meadow, Dazzle Beach, Glade of Trust, and Forgotten Lands are available for you to explore and make your own – for a small Dreamlight cost.

Feel more at home with updates to housing! You’ll now be able to remove mailboxes from secondary player houses, further customize the layout size of rooms in your main house AND secondary houses, and offset the center of wallpapers.

We can’t wait for you to explore the Aladdin-inspired Realm, befriend Jasmine and Aladdin, and discover all that the Tales of Agrabah update has to offer. Don’t forget to connect with us on our official social media to share your in-game adventures with us by tagging us in your content!

items.text: Hey Valley Villagers!
We are so happy to have given you a first look at the Tales of Agrabah free update in our latest Developer Update video! Today, we are sharing an even closer look in these patch notes.

Prepare for your upcoming journey to the Aladdin-inspired Realm, featuring an iconic duo (and their trusty Magic Carpet) and all the adventures and perks unlocked alongside them! Join us on a magical (carpet) ride to discover a whole new Realm - and more!
Disney Dreamlight Valley’s Tales of Agrabah Update arrives on February 26th, 2025, so let’s dive in!
A new Realm door opens! Travel to the Dream Castle and through the Aladdin Realm door to arrive in Agrabah’s market inspired by Disney’s Aladdin.
Aladdin and Jasmine join the Valley, bringing with them new Friendship Quests, and majestic Friendship Rewards!
Through your Realm adventures, unlock a familiar flying carpet as a companion!

Spring into action with a new in-game event, and the return of Eggstravaganza! Search your Valley for clovers and eggs, craft and unlock unique rewards, and make WALL-E’s day.

What’s that? You want to cook more meals with less hassle? Yes chef! Queue up a variety of meals for a small Dreamlight cost with the all-new Slow Cooker!

But wait, there’s more! Here are some UI changes that are sure to make life in the Valley easier.

You can also expect additional stock in daily rotations in Scrooge McDuck’s Store as well as new optional content in weekly Premium Shop rotations.

releases.displayName: The Storybook Vale - Part 1 Patch Notes

items.text: Hey Valley Villagers!

This week, we turn the page to a new chapter for Disney Dreamlight Valley as we celebrate the release of a new paid expansion pass, Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Storybook Vale - Part 1. Travel to a new world and capture treasured tales to unveil beloved Disney and Pixar stories! Meet heroes and villains who have epic trials to undertake, stories to reassemble, and friendships to recover. Master a new Royal Tool and collect all manner of new rewards to further express your creativity and style! All this and more awaits you in the Vale.

Not only that, but this update also includes a range of bug fixes that impact all owners of Disney Dreamlight Valley. These fixes pave the way for our next free update – “Sew Delightful” – which will release on December 4, 2024. Stay tuned for more details about this update in the coming week!
But returning our focus to this week, Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Storybook Vale - Part 1 arrives on November 20, 2024! Check out all the details of this update below:

notes.title: NEW CONTENT (THE STORYBOOK VALE EXPANSION PASS OWNERS)

items.text: A new land to explore! Step into Storybook Vale and discover a land made up of myths and fairytales come to life, comprised of 3 stunning and expansive new biomes: the Bind, Everafter, and Mythopia.
A new questline! Meet the Lorekeeper and puzzle through the motivations of two competing rulers in this epic new tale, filled with new friends and new quests.

3 new characters! As you adventure through the Vale, join forces with Merida from Disney and Pixar’s Brave, Flynn Rider from Disney’s Tangled, and Hades from Disney’s Hercules, unlocking new Friendship Quests and new unique items along the way.

New Royal Tool! Harness the power of the Royal Net to capture Snippets – living embodiments of the Lorekeeper’s scattered pages –and piece together the story of the Vale. Show off this tool with a new Photo Mode pose, as well.

New puzzle and quest types! Complete beautiful tapestries that tell the stories behind classic Disney and Pixar films and delve into Trials – new quests inspired by fairytales and myths – which are sure to put your adventuring skills to the test.
New animal companions! Discover new critters to befriend, as well as their many variations, in each of the Vale’s new biomes.
New shipment alert! Browse a new batch of goods in Scrooge McDuck’s Store, available for owners of the expansion pass!
New renos! Scrooge McDuck’s Store and Chez Remy each receive a visual refresh to match their surroundings in the Bind.
New decorations, clothing and collectibles! Collect all manner of new items to express your creativity in these new surroundings and unlock a wide range of new crafting and cooking recipes.

Hey, Valley Villagers!

We're returning to Disney's The Lion King Realm in our latest free update to welcome two NEW friends! Now live on all platforms, embark on a "Jungle Getaway" to discover the art of relaxation with a laid-back duo and rock out with thrilling rewards in the latest Star Path—The Night Show!
Plenty of other surprises await, from a limited-time collaboration to many top-requested features and quality-of-life updates. Read on to learn more!

notes.title: Return to The Lion King Realm in the Light of Day!

items.text: First revealed in our Valley Vignette blog from earlier this year, two new Villagers arrive in this update—Timon and Pumbaa from The Lion King!

As you return to their Realm, it seems like the stress of saving the Valley time and time again has taken its toll—with Timon declaring that you must learn the ways of hakuna matata! Of course, learning the art of relaxation isn't a one-step process, and you'll need to experience a few days and nights in the Realm. (Don't worry; time passes differently within!)

After you're sufficiently relaxed and have given your easygoing pals a hand with a sticky situation, they'll arrive in your Valley—bringing with them unique Quests, Friendship rewards, and aromas…? Continue the fun by helping them feel at home—which involves sorting out a "stinky" situation with Pumbaa and aiding Timon in cataloging the Valley's critters.

notes.title: Get Ready to ROCK with a New Star Path!

items.text: Neon lights and pyrotechnic delights await you in this season's Star Path—The Night Show!

We're challenging you to build the stage of your dreams with furniture items featuring unique special effects such as neon, changing lights, fire, and more! Then, amp up your Avatar with rebellious clothing inspired by Disney Villains, Disney Princess characters, and of course, rock music.

This Star Path features a reduced number of rewards (reflected in a discounted Premium-tier cost and number of duties) as we build up to more content releases later this year—but don't let that fool you! It's full of rock-star-realness and high-quality collectibles! Make sure to complete it before it ends on November 27.

Loungefly backpacks are available now in the Valley! We're thrilled to share that we've collaborated with Loungefly, bringing multiple recreations of their statement-making backpacks to the Valley. Styles that you may already have in your personal collection can either be found in-game by completing The Night Show Star Path, as well as in the Premium Shop for a limited time. You can also redeem the code DDV2024OOOOO† in-game by November 20 at 9 am ET / 2 pm UTC to claim a Mickey BOO! Loungefly Backpack for your Avatar!

And don't forget to share a screenshot or fan art of your Avatar wearing one of the in-game Loungefly collaboration items for a chance to win one of six physical Halloween-themed bags in our Haunted Holiday Sweepstakes! Full sweepstakes details and rules here: https://gleam.io/1LFHa/haunted-holiday-sweepstakes
Scrooge McDuck gets new stock! Make sure to stop by Scrooge McDuck's Store for a chance to purchase additional furniture from Realms and Villager homes as they appear in daily stock rotations.
Premium Shop updates! New content arrives in weekly rotations, along with a recommendation system to help you collect items you may have missed.

In addition to the exciting new content coming to the Premium Shop this update, we are also adding a new Moonstone-pack option to the Moonstone menu in the Premium Shop. This pack will include both Moonstones and a seasonal Valley-inspired cosmetic item. It will be available for a limited time, and different seasonal Valley-inspired cosmetic items may be offered with future updates.
† Redemption code features both zeroes and the letter O: DDV20[One "ZERO"]24OOOOO[Five "LETTER O"].

The Trick-or-Treat event returns! From October 23 to 31, collect Candy Bowls that appear in the Plaza to gather green, purple, and red Candies. These sweets can be consumed or gifted to complete Event Duties—granting you seasonal rewards!

This year's event also brings with it a new craftable furniture item: Turn your event treats into Mickey's Halloween Candy Bowl! A crafting recipe will arrive in your in-game mailbox once the event starts.

Need the perfect Halloween costume? We've got you covered! All players can look forward to claiming an Evil Queen Costume FOR FREE from the Premium Shop as part of our seasonal festivities closer to Halloween. Keep an eye out on our social media and in-game for more news on its arrival!

We want to extend a huge thanks to everyone who continues to participate in sharing their feedback on each and every update. Here are just a few of the highlights arriving in Jungle Getaway, inspired by players like you!

Customize the way you play! Arriving in this update are three additional options in the Settings menu in the Gameplay and Controls tabs. If you use a controller, check out the "New Edit Mode Controls" option to swap between editing playstyles, featuring a locked or free cursor.

The new "Use Alternative Sprint Button" allows you to use the newer Sprint button option that was introduced in our Dapper Delights update—or revert to the previous button option. Lastly, enabling the "Tap to Sprint" option will allow you to sprint by tapping your preferred sprint button option versus holding it.

Take to the air with new glider options! Get more use out of your favorite wing back accessories with a new glider option! All wings currently available in-game will be able to be worn as a glider accessory, replacing the "surfing" glider animation with a fluttering animation more befitting wings.
Never forget the task at hand with new tracking options for duties and crafting recipes, allowing them to appear instead of a Quest in the upper left portion of the screen.

Your Royal Tools become more useful with a new Photo Mode option, allowing your Avatar to hold a Royal Tool while snapping a pic! You'll be able to feature other handheld accessories as well, when equipped.
We can't wait to see how you enjoy diving into the Jungle Getaway update! Make sure to connect with us on our official social media accounts below and tag us in your in-game photos!

Hey Valley Villagers!
We hope you enjoyed the recent Developer Update video! With our next content update releasing a little later this week, it’s about time to dig into patch notes.

Not only will we be returning to a familiar Realm for a new adventure in a new light, but we've also got a stunning collaboration coming to the game and a bunch of quality-of-life improvements that draw upon all-important player feedback.
Disney Dreamlight Valley’s “Jungle Getaway” Update arrives on October 9, 2024, so check out all the details below:
Return to Disney’s The Lion King Realm and experience the Realm in a new light with a day and night cycle, new quests, and new friends. Speaking of...
Two new characters! Embrace equal parts relaxation and antics as Timon and Pumbaa from Disney’s The Lion King arrive in the Valley, alongside new Friendship Quests and unique new items.

A new Star Path! Turn your Valley into a music festival with The Night Show Star Path, featuring furniture that’ll literally help you set the stage, a Rockstar Turtle animal companion, as well as clothing inspired by Disney Villains, Disney Princess, and rock music.

Dress to impress! Dig into an exciting collaboration with Loungefly, in which recreations of Loungefly’s statement-making backpacks will arrive in the game across the Star Path, Premium Shop and social media. Keep an eye out for more details in the launch day blog!
Prepare your pumpkins! The Trick or Treat in-game event returns to the Valley from October 23 to 31, featuring a brand new reward!
Weekly rotations to look forward to! Keep an eye out for new optional items in the Premium Shop (alongside some returning favorites), as well as new, weekly DreamSnaps challenges and rewards.
New shipment alert! Scrooge McDuck’s Store has received a new batch of goods for sale, including additional Realm decor!

Adjusted available Moonstone packs to introduce a new option that includes both Moonstones and a seasonal Valley inspired cosmetic item. This pack will be offered for a limited time and different seasonal cosmetic items may be offered with future updates.
* Please note: Disney Dreamlight Valley Arcade Edition does not include seasonal Star Paths or the Premium Shop.

Added a toggle to the Settings > Controls menu to select between two different camera control methods when using a gamepad in Edit Mode. Players will be able to select between an option that’s akin to the game’s original, free-flowing control style, or a new hybrid approach that locks the cursor to the center of the screen, while also giving the ability to move it freely by holding a button.
Please note: This control methods selection will apply to outdoor areas. Edit Mode while in the Player House will default to the original control style.

Added a toggle to the Settings > Controls menu to select between two different sprinting control methods when using a gamepad, allowing players to revert to the previous button mapping or use the updated button mapping (Left Bumper) introduced last update.
Added a toggle to the Settings > Gameplay menu to enable a “Tap to Sprint” control option, allowing players to start and stop sprinting at the press of a button without needing to hold it.

Added full support for wireless controllers on Steam without requiring Steam Input to be enabled. If you have not previously adjusted this option, the game will now default to "Built-In" support (our recommendation) and can be adjusted as needed in the Settings > Controls menu.
Scrooge’s McDuck’s Store will now display furniture items in place of empty clothing mannequins, including in the window displays.
Added a “skip” button to the DreamSnaps voting screen, allowing players to skip up to 10 votes per day.
Added the ability for avatars to hold hand accessories (i.e. umbrellas) and Royal Tools while in Photo Mode.

Added a new “Recommended” section to the Premium Shop, which will feature four additional items or bundles each week. The contents of this section will differ from player to player, based on their Premium Shop interests.

Added the ability to equip wearable wings as a Glider in the Wardrobe. All wings currently available in the game will be equipable this way, replacing the “surfing” Glider animation with a fluttering animation more befitting of wings.

releases.displayName: Discover the Dapper Delights Update and Expansion Pass Act III!

items.text: Hey Valley Villagers!

Get ready for double the fun, and twice the excitement with two content releases today – our twelfth free update, “Dapper Delights”, and “Treasures of Time” – Act III of the Disney Dreamlight Valley: A Rift in Time expansion pass – available to all expansion pass owners.

This begs the question: will you start your next adventure in the Valley, or on Eternity Isle? Whichever you choose – you’re in for a treat! Each content update brings with it a new Villager, thrilling furniture, and dazzling cosmetic items for your Avatar. Our “Dapper Delights” Star Path also begins today – injecting your time spent in the Valley with even more content to complete and rewards to discover!

notes.title: Tantalize your taste buds at Tiana’s Palace!

items.text: Originally announced in our 2023 Showcase Stream, Tiana finally makes her way to Disney Dreamlight Valley! But, before you can get cooking, you’ll need to do some questing in the Glade of Trust first…

There, you’ll find a mysterious cookbook – something you should ask the Valley’s ‘littlest chef’ about! Through the magic of cooking, sharing memories, and of course, a little bit of Dreamlight, Tiana will join your Valley – bringing with her not only new quests and friendship rewards, but her restaurant, Tiana’s Palace, alongside plenty of flavorful recipes for you to cook up and share with your Villagers!

Of course – that’s not arriving with the Valley’s latest Disney Princess! Tiana is dabbling in takeout dining and will sell a selection of pre-made meals at her Meal Stall – the perfect place to chow down for any Valley Hero on the go.

notes.title: Be the Bee’s Knees with new Star Path fashions!

items.text: Bring the roaring twenties style n' swing to your Valley with the ‘Dapper Delights’ Star Path! Expect to cook up fanciful meals and spend time with Tiana to complete new duties to claim ‘Lily pad Tokens’ that can be redeemed for flapper-fashions, art nouveau furniture – and even a dapper look for Donald Duck.
Scrooge McDuck’s Store also receives new stock with the addition of some clothing items and furniture arriving from Realms – and even the Store’s furnishings themselves!

notes.title: Revel in regal-realness with a new bundle!

items.text: Just in time for World Princess Week (Aug 25th-31st) – add some seaside splendor to your Valley with a new Premium Shop Bundle! You’re cordially invited to tap into your inner Disney Prince or Princess with exclusive royal fashions and hairstyles - Ariel also joins in on the dress up fun with a Dream Style inspired by her classic pink gown from Disney’s The Little Mermaid.

Your Player Home also gets the royal treatment with a new House Dream Style along with interior and exterior furniture items – all set for you to decorate and transform your Valley or player home into a little piece of Atlantica.

notes.title: Bridging your Valleys with cross-play – and other Community-Driven features!

items.text: We’re thrilled to enhance your Disney Dreamlight Valley play sessions with a bounty of new features and improvements, inspired by feedback and suggestions from our Community! Thank you to everyone who continues to participate in sharing their thoughts with us on our social media posts or surveys. Here are just a few of the highlights arriving in this update, as requested by players like you!
All players, regardless of platform, can now participate in multiplayer play! We can’t wait to see your selfies from your shared Valley Visit adventures.

notes.title: Wardrobe and Furniture Mode Improvements galore!

items.text: In addition to the much-requested search bar, you can now mark items in your Furniture and Wardrobe menus as favorites; pushing items to the top, or hide those you aren’t currently vibing with.

notes.title: Save your faves! Outfit presets are HERE!

items.text: Save up to four outfits and name them in the Wardrobe Menu, enabling you to quickly swap between you favorite ‘fits.

notes.title: Upgrade your patio with updates to Remy’s Special Deliveries!

items.text: We loved seeing everyone engaging with this new feature – based off of your feedback, deliveries will now reward additional Wrought Iron, and we’ve lowered the amounts of materials required to craft certain tables and chairs.
… and that’s not all! Be sure to check out our full Patch Notes here for even more features and improvements arriving in Dapper Delights!
* While Disney Dreamlight Valley now supports cross-play between all platforms, cross-save between PlayStation and other platforms is not available currently.
† Multiplayer requires an internet connection, and may require an active subscription to online services, depending on what platform you use. See here for more information.

notes.title: Experience the Final Act of Disney Dreamlight Valley: A Rift in Time!

items.text: It’s time to return to Eternity Isle as the story continues, and concludes, in the Disney Dreamlight Valley: A Rift in Time expansion pass! The clock is ticking in Act III – “Treasures of Time” – and it’s going to take plenty of ingenuity and imagination to foil Jafar’s plans for good.

If you’re just joining us on your Eternity Isle adventures, or you need a recap – we’ve got you covered. The Disney Dreamlight Valley: A Rift in Time expansion pass opens a whole new world to play in filled with brand new quests, Villagers, features, and even a new tool – the Royal Hourglass. All set in a mysterious, time-forgotten land, its epic journey rolls out in three acts – the final act arriving TODAY!
Our story left off with a Jafar stealing the Spark of Imagination – causing the sky to break… again. The appearance of these sky rifts not only threatens Eternity Isle, but your Villagers, as well...

It’ll be a race against time to turn back the effects of Jafar’s schemes – but you won’t be alone. Your Eternity Isle companions will aid you with their own imaginative ideas, helping you to finally enter Jafar’s Palace. With plenty of puzzles and surprises inside, it’s up to you to uncover the rest of the story – and a fitting end to all of Jafar’s machinations.

Of course, Disney Dreamlight Valley is a home to heroes and villains alike, and it won’t be long until the help of a certain royal vizier is needed. After the events of “Treasures of Time”, Jafar joins your Valley as a companion with his own friendship quests, rewards, and charismatic charms.

Scramblecoin enthusiasts also add more magic to their boards with a new Jafar figurine – his tendency towards the unpredictable eking through with a playstyle that changes every turn it’s on the board.

We’re so excited to see you explore and experience all that our “Dapper Delights” Update and Act III of the Disney Dreamlight Valley: A Rift in Time expansion pass have to offer! Make sure to connect with us on our official social media accounts below and tag us in your in-game photos!

Hey Valley Villagers!

It’s the Monday before an update launch and you know what that means: patch notes! Over the last two weeks, we’ve shared some exciting previews of what you can expect from this update – from the Valley Vignette to the Developer Update – and we’re excited to share even more today.

Similar to the “Thrills & Frills” Update in May, the “Dapper Delights” Update will include some much-anticipated content for base game owners, as well as the thrilling conclusion to Disney Dreamlight Valley: A Rift in Time, available to all expansion pass owners. As always, scroll down for a breakdown of new content, quality of life improvements, bug fixes and more you can expect from this update!
Prepare yourself! Disney Dreamlight Valley’s “Dapper Delights” Update arrives on August 21, 2024! Check out all the details below:
A new character! Revel in the magic of cooking as you welcome Tiana from Disney’s The Princess and the Frog to the Valley, alongside new Friendship Quests and unique new items.
A new restaurant! Tiana’s Palace is open for business, providing villagers a new spot to grab a meal with friends.
A new stall! Visit Tiana’s Meal Stall to purchase delicious meals, rotating daily.
A new Star Path – also named Dapper Delights! – makes a statement with a new Dream Style for Donald Duck and clothing, hairstyles, makeup, and furniture, inspired by the Roaring Twenties.

A new Signature Bundle in the Premium Shop! Ariel's Royal Bundle offers a wide range of customization items inspired by Disney’s The Little Mermaid, including a Dream Style for Ariel, a House Style inspired by Prince Eric’s village, and clothing items and furniture that exudes opulence.
Weekly rotations to look forward to! Keep an eye out for new optional items in the Premium Shop (alongside some returning favorites), as well as new, weekly DreamSnaps challenges and rewards.
New shipment alert! Scrooge McDuck’s Store has received a new batch of goods for sale, including new clothes!
A new type of furniture! Keep an eye out for future furniture that allows you to interact with it to gather random villagers for a photo op.

If you previously purchased the Nefarious Tool Set or Skeletal Tool Set from the Premium Shop, you will receive a complimentary, matching Royal Hourglass skin for these sets. These Royal Hourglass styles will be included as part of these two tool sets, moving forward.
* Please note: Disney Dreamlight Valley Arcade Edition does not include seasonal Star Paths or the Premium Shop.
Return to Ancient’s Landing for Act III – “Treasures of Time” – which is the final act of Disney Dreamlight Valley: A Rift in Time!
Jafar makes his way from Eternity Isle to the Valley, opening the door to new Friendship Quests and new unique items!
Bring a touch of unpredictability to Scramblecoin with the new Jafar figurine, which changes its movement with each turn it spends on the board.
Added a search filter to the Furniture and Wardrobe menus.
Added the ability to mark items as “Favorites” or “Hidden” in the Furniture and Wardrobe menus, adding these items to relevant new categories and surfacing favorite items to the top of these menus.
Added the ability to save custom outfit presets, making it easy to switch between full outfits.
Added a “new item” tag to items in the Wardrobe and Furniture menus.
Added new sorting options to the Wardrobe and Furniture menus.
Added the ability to remove all furniture from a room at once, resetting a room.
Added 2 new full body Avatar poses to Photo Mode.
Added a toggle to the Settings menu that replaces fishing and timebending button presses with a “hold button” prompt.
Added a toggle to the cooking menu that turns off the “results” screen and animation while cooking, speeding up the cooking process.
